faqs.q: Is there electrical involved (including any internal or external lighting)?
faqs.a: If it is just a disconnect/reconnect then no electrical permit is required If there is new wiring or a service change then an electrical permit is required and you need to complete the Sub-Contractor Application found in resources Sign permits are issued within seven days after submittal of a complete application. Apply online with the Arvada Permits Site.
